query: INSERT INTO ops.email_deliveries(message_type,recipient_hash,template_version,object_type,object_id,status,attempt_count) VALUES($1,$2,'v1',$3,$4,'SENDING',1) ON CONFLICT(message_type,object_id,recipient_hash) WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET status='SENDING',attempt_count=ops.email_deliveries.attempt_count+1,last_error_code=NULL RETURNING id
